entities.title: C# library design documents
entities.summary: engine-interface.md: the C# interface sketch of the planned engine (ITemporalEngine, UtvResult<T>, EvaluationContext and the value records), with a usage example.
entities.purpose: Keeps the code sketch of the C# shape of docs/operations.md. The plan's decisions, milestones and wanted work are recorded in implementations/csharp/.dev (decisions.json, roadmap.json, backlog.json), which say what library 0.3 realizes of it.
boundaries: The sketch is a plan, not the library's API; the README describes the API that exists.
docs/operations.md and docs/aesthetics-review.md link to engine-interface.md by its path, so the file stays where it is.
